caseName: Bank of America National Trust & Sayings Ass'n v. 203 North LaSalle Street Partnership
caseNameFull: BANK OF AMERICA NATIONAL TRUST AND SAYINGS ASSOCIATION v. 203 NORTH LaSALLE STREET PARTNERSHIP

opinions.text: Motion of American College of Real Estate Lawyers for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae granted. Motion of American Council of Life Insurance for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae granted. Motion of American Bankers Association, et al, for leave to file a brief as amici curiae granted. Petition for *1028writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Seventh Circuit granted.
